summary.title: Florin Pop - YouTube
summary.one_liner: A short piece of advice on finding app ideas by building for your own problems, validating with free users, then monetizing with paid tiers or one-time payments.
takeaways: Build projects that solve your own problems first; everyone has problems worth solving.
Share what you build where your target users gather, and give them free access to collect feedback.
Once the product has some traction, add 1-3 paid premium tiers with extra features.
Start with a one-time payment, then add a subscription once sales and a recurring service justify it.
If a product fails, you still gain a solved problem and experience to talk about; try another idea.
summary.summary: The page is a short piece of advice, not a full tutorial, aimed at people who say they don't know what to build online. It walks through a loop: build for your own problems, share publicly to find others with the same problems, offer free access for feedback, and iterate quickly. It then covers monetization, suggesting paid tiers once the product is polished and choosing a one-time payment before adding a subscription. The listing credits Florin Pop as a contributor to the florinpop17/app-ideas repository; the page itself is a YouTube channel URL with little channel-specific content in the text provided.
